items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I bought it from Avery Fisher, who had a record, phonograph, and radio shop. I remember how nice Mr. Fisher was to me.

ctx.x: Do you remember the [K?] that came later?

Yes I do, but the one I loved was the Ansley Dynaphone. I bought an Ansley Dynaphone, which was a beautiful cabinet, very modern, very simple. It was, I think, one of the best machines that one could afford in those days. I bought it from Avery Fisher, who had a record, phonograph, and radio shop. I remember how nice Mr. Fisher was to me. I was a freshman in college at the time. But that was a heck of a machine. I kept it until well after the war, when it finally fell apart, broke down. I don’t know what I got…
And remember all the radio shows late at night, when you could hear bands.
